lines:
flowchart TD
    Open["Open accepted mockup or recoverable working draft"] --> Canvas["Render layered and grouped SVG canvas"]
    Canvas --> Tool{"Choose simple editing tool"}
    Tool --> Select["Select element or group"]
    Select --> Move["Drag or resize"]
    Select --> Text["Edit label inline"]
    Select --> Delete["Delete or duplicate"]
    Select --> Group["Group, ungroup, bring forward, or send backward"]
    Tool --> Add["Add primitive"]
    Add --> Primitive{"Panel, text, button, field, image placeholder, or divider"}
    Primitive --> Canvas
    Tool --> Pencil["Draw red freehand annotation"]
    Pencil --> Annotation["Store vector path in separate annotation layer"]
    Tool --> Eraser["Erase annotation stroke"]
    Tool --> Callout["Add optional short text callout"]
    Move --> Dirty["Record ordered edit operation and mark draft dirty"]
    Text --> Dirty
    Delete --> Dirty
    Group --> Dirty
    Annotation --> Dirty
    Eraser --> Dirty
    Callout --> Dirty
    Dirty --> History{"Undo or redo"}
    History --> Canvas
    Dirty --> Save["Persist recoverable working SVG, edit log, and annotations"]
    Save --> Request["Request AI revision when ready"]
    Request --> Pending["Pending agent revision context"]
